title: Home guide: the disappearing coin and the bent straw
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 22 (Home practical guide and safety card: coin and straw (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: See refraction and explain it with ray diagrams.
equipment: A glass of water and a straw
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put the coin in the bottom of the empty mug. Move your head back until the coin just disappears behind the rim.
Keep still while someone slowly pours water into the mug. What happens?
Put the straw in the glass of water and look from the side.
Draw a ray diagram for each, showing light bending as it leaves the water.
